run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# Java Virtual Threads: Release and Synchronization Improvements

Virtual threads, introduced in Java 21 via JEP 444, are lightweight threads provided by the JDK rather than the operating system. In JDK 21, virtual threads can become pinned to their underlying platform threads in certain situations, including inside synchronized constructs. A later proposal, JEP 491, targets JDK 24 to synchronize virtual threads without pinning, improving the scalability of Java code that uses synchronized methods and statements.

## Virtual Threads in Java 21

Java virtual threads were introduced in Java 21 through JEP 444. Unlike traditional threads, which are managed by the operating system, virtual threads are lightweight threads provided by the JDK itself. [evidence:2e76ee0717c9c3356c10122175db075d53f9a0f05c19fa68]

## Synchronization and Pinning in JDK 21

In JDK 21, virtual threads can become pinned to their underlying platform threads in certain circumstances. This occurs for synchronous file I/O operations and when calling Object.wait. [evidence:765d05ed786eddade360c776a94eb446e064ddaaa639451c]

## JEP 491 and JDK 24

JEP 491 is proposed to target JDK 24. Its goal is to synchronize virtual threads without pinning, improving the scalability of Java code that uses synchronized methods and statements by arranging for virtual threads that block in such constructs to release their underlying platform threads for use by other virtual threads. [evidence:c87a8806713be911d0cf66dde68af6f682ae8b802f4dbb76] [evidence:34751ce593f82b59495aff4a30523f792030d58e87d9b715] [evidence:8dbad292e67e9c1b499db101940733f167daec6c207635ea]

## 对比表

| JDK Version | JEP | Status | Synchronization and Pinning Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Java 21 | JEP 444 | Introduced virtual threads | Virtual threads can be pinned during synchronous file I/O and Object.wait [evidence:2e76ee0717c9c3356c10122175db075d53f9a0f05c19fa68] [evidence:765d05ed786eddade360c776a94eb446e064ddaaa639451c] |
| JDK 24 | JEP 491 | Proposed to target | Virtual threads synchronize without pinning, releasing platform threads when blocking in synchronized constructs [evidence:c87a8806713be911d0cf66dde68af6f682ae8b802f4dbb76] [evidence:34751ce593f82b59495aff4a30523f792030d58e87d9b715] [evidence:8dbad292e67e9c1b499db101940733f167daec6c207635ea] |
